name: Pragati Scholarship (81 for Uttarakhand girl students (Diploma) and 50 for Graduation)
benefit: Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per annum is provided for girl students at the Diploma and Graduation levels.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a girl student. - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000/-. - A maximum of two girl children are allowed per family to avail of this scholarship.
